description: Revert to the stable 8-layer/128-head configuration with the best-performing hyperparameters (Matrix LR 0.06, WD 0.1) and device batch size 128, as this combination has consistently yielded the lowest val_bpb (0.9905) without instability, avoiding the risks of aggressive LR/low WD or capacity changes that have failed or underperformed in previous attempts.
